item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting: an imagined visual metaphor for cognition as competing possibilities, provisional coherence, and unresolved tension. Choose deep indigo, bruised violet, smoky ivory, sharp chartreuse, and small concentrations of incandescent vermilion. Concentrate dense, interleaved brushwork off-center toward the lower left, pressing against a broad, quiet expanse of thinly washed ivory in the upper right. Let translucent layers veil earlier gestures without fully concealing them. Alternate scraped, broken pigment with thick impasto, dry-brush friction, soft stains, and occasional wet collisions of color. Establish an irregular rhythm of accumulation, interruption, and release. Some gestures should almost converge, then dissolve or change direction; others should persist faintly beneath successive layers. Use abrupt contrasts sparingly, allowing one small vermilion passage to carry disproportionate intensity. Make the empty space feel active through subtle shifts in temperature and barely visible paint residue. Preserve ambiguity, asymmetry, tactile materiality, and spatial tension. Avoid a polished digital finish or decorative repetition. The painting must fill the entire image edge to edge. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}
